searchText: Have other clients implemented the v2 blobsbyrange/root rpc protocol for electra https://github.com/ethereum/consensus-specs/blob/dev/specs/electra/p2p-interface.md#blobsidecarsbyroot-v2 ? seems like the only difference between v1 and v2 versions is the length of the list. Not sure when we typically bump rpc protocol versions but doing this for a length increase seems unnecessary imo. Do other clients think this is good to have? cc <@592004585506340885> Hmm yeah I’m not sure this is necessary either. I thought we bumped the version to prevent any confusion around the fork. But as you mentioned privately, we didn’t bump the version of BlocksByRange/Root v2 in Deneb under similar circumstances. I agree. It doesnt seem necessary to have https://github.com/status-im/nimbus-eth2/pull/6769 cc <@654267572107083777> yeah, I didn't see any other differences either, and tend to agree We questioned the same thing in lodestar. It also presents some implementation challenges to us. Don’t think it is really necessary Made a PR for this: https://github.com/ethereum/consensus-specs/pull/4077 Thanks for the PR, we will want this for devnet5 right? I think we should try to include it in devnet5. +1, we should add it to the list. cc <@199561711278227457> I've added it to the consensus specs section. Probably worth mention it here: https://github.com/ethereum/pm/issues/1218 (?)

excerpts.author: pawandhananjay
excerpts.content:
Have other clients implemented the v2 blobsbyrange/root rpc protocol for electra https://github.com/ethereum/consensus-specs/blob/dev/specs/electra/p2p-interface.md#blobsidecarsbyroot-v2 ?
 seems like the only difference between v1 and v2 versions is the length of the list. Not sure when we typically bump rpc protocol versions but doing this for a length increase seems unnecessary imo. Do other clients think this is good to have?

excerpts.author: jtraglia
excerpts.content: Hmm yeah I’m not sure this is necessary either. I thought we bumped the version to prevent any confusion around the fork. But as you mentioned privately, we didn’t bump the version of BlocksByRange/Root v2 in Deneb under similar circumstances.

excerpts.author: terencechain
excerpts.content: I agree. It doesnt seem necessary to have

excerpts.author: tersec
excerpts.content: yeah, I didn't see any other differences either, and tend to agree

excerpts.author: nc1234
excerpts.content: We questioned the same thing in lodestar. It also presents some implementation challenges to us. Don’t think it is really necessary

excerpts.content: Thanks for the PR, we will want this for devnet5 right?

excerpts.author: jtraglia
excerpts.content: I think we should try to include it in devnet5.

excerpts.content: +1, we should add it to the list. cc <@199561711278227457>
